programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
隆行天下之重走八千里路雲和月普
手匠傳承粵韓
programme.desc: 吳哥金屬工藝是柬埔寨特別的藝術品，本集將會講述製作過程及其背後意義。印度教神話故事對柬埔寨藝術的影響十分深遠, 工匠把故事刻在工藝品上, 希望可以讓故事繼續流傳, 並延續祖先文化的傳統

programme.title: 仨心友行粵
programme.desc: 位於塔崑山附近的住宅，被大片林木與河流包圍，十足世外桃園。「閨密睇樓團」先後參觀復古風、度假風的別墅，敏之還獲高Ling、嘉欣奉上四手按摩，好寫意。高Ling離隊返港途中，打開姊妹們準備的愛心便當，更覺感動！另邊廂，陳凱琳飛抵哥打峇魯會合敏之，隨即到舊式茶室醫肚。道北有「小泰國」之稱，兩位人母試坐地道火車，並交流養兒經。見識過當地最大的坐佛像後，二人化身布藝學徒，投入繪畫、上色步驟，壓力一掃而空。

programme.title: 港產旅行團粵PG
programme.desc: 牛年新春，衍峰、祖儀、穎彤前往昂坪棧道行大運！無限踏步棧道梯級，運動盲穎彤可會應付得來？考驗未完，三人還要挑戰離地驚險步道！完成辛苦的棧道行程，在昂坪市集品嚐港式小吃，不忘到心經簡林洗滌心靈。Ben Sir、淑雅、衍峰實測本地盆菜團，尋覓流水響「天空之鏡」秘境，還有屏山盆菜等着餵飽三人！接着親親羊駝、壁畫村內感受藝術氣息、紅磚屋市集買手信，好圓滿。嘉賓馬貫東帶祖儀到馬灣荒廢舊村打卡，拍出頹廢美感。

programme.title: 周六聊Teen谷粵
programme.desc: 德國於二戰後分裂為東德與西德，由美、英、法、蘇四國分別管理。由於理念各異，民眾生活截然不同，令當時不少東德人希望逃往西德，東德當局遂下令建造柏林圍牆。谷主凱婷講述這段歷史，還展示了柏林圍牆逃亡路線的模擬圖。眾谷們又討論柏林圍牆倒下的原因，汛文、泳嘉猜測是於德國統一後才發生，已作資料搜集的凱婷卻指拍檔倒轉了因果，何出此言？泳嘉曾到訪柏林圍牆，更與著名塗鴉《兄弟之吻》打卡，該幅圖畫的由來又是怎樣？

programme.title: 警聲百二秒 III粵
programme.desc: 「警聲百二秒」系列再次歸來，《警聲百二秒 III》由警方代表聯同眾多藝員參與演出，會繼續透過有趣的故事情節，介紹香港警務處更多部門的工作、更多防罪訊息，讓廣大市民可輕鬆「全方位」了解警隊更多資訊。

programme.title: 一路前行粵普
programme.desc: 一部聚焦中國生態保護，綠色高品質發展的環保公益紀實節目。透過沉浸式觀察新時代環保議題，並邀請胡歌、劉濤、陳龍三位明星親身參與，共同完成一場綠色低碳生活的行動。

programme.title: 成人教科書粵
programme.desc: 生與死是每個人都要面對、經歷的人生課題，洪永城要四位小朋友填寫死亡證，想像自己的死亡日期、地點、死因等，有女生笑言會因太富有而招致殺身之禍？小朋友如掌握生殺大權，哪些相中生命可殺？哪些不可殺？問到會否吃豬肉時，有人自稱不會殺豬，但別人殺了卻會吃。節目組還會讓一名十一歲女生籌辦生前派對，並邀請其家人、親友出席。主角女孩因父母在台上的分享而感觸，參與活動的洪永城及其他小朋友又有甚麼難忘感受？

programme.title: 地球大神秘粵
programme.desc: 今年是人類充滿惶恐不安的一年，網絡上流傳不少大災難的預言：中東戰火、日本超級大地震等，我們的明天究竟會怎樣呢？很多人想預知未來，研究它的真假，在網絡資訊爆炸的時代，越講越真，越知道反而越驚，就好像聖經一早預言：『人想起將要臨到世界的事，就嚇得魂不附體』這一刻，站在文明懸崖上的我們，是否正要見證這古老預言成為現實？在全新一輯的地球大神秘，我們會繼續從世界各地神秘事件，探討各種預言的真確，還會同被稱為最準確重要的預言書《聖經》作對比，在末世中得到真正的平安保障。

programme.title: 新幹線戰士 改變世界粵日
programme.desc: 茜向良太和太晴追問怪物的真身，高輪見狀決定把茜帶去超鐵機，並邀請他成為駕駛員，誰知茜聽見「期望」兩字後便一口拒絕。UNKNOWN再次出現，太晴和良太陷入苦戰，危急關頭茜駕駛E6小町號前來助陣。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 「WORKOUT 2GETHER」再次展開，教練Mandy姐姐引領大家以兩張紙張先行熱身，做法是怎樣的？緊接的上身肌力訓練亦全程手持兩張紙來做，除了有游泳、扇風等動作，還會模仿招財貓揮手。另會手持彩虹鐘鍛練下肢肌力，過程中要做出弓步、踢腿等動作，同時要跟隨拍子敲鐘。將耍樂融入運動，有助提升小朋友的鍛練動力。「動物好萌友」環節，帶大家認識唐貓「嬌嬌」之餘，也會介紹貓咪日常如何保持自身清潔。

programme.title: 查查林部隊粵英
programme.desc: 森林裡神秘怪事頻生。巨大陷阱出現，栗子消失，昆蟲失蹤，橡實從天而降！要交由大偵探Peet和朋友Baba和Molly組成的查查林部隊調查。牠們未必是最能幹的偵探隊，但往往能夠迎刃而解，揭開大自然奧秘。

programme.title: 查查林部隊粵英
programme.desc: 森林裡神秘怪事頻生。巨大陷阱出現，栗子消失，昆蟲失蹤，橡實從天而降！要交由大偵探Peet和朋友Baba和Molly組成的查查林部隊調查。牠們未必是最能幹的偵探隊，但往往能夠迎刃而解，揭開大自然奧秘。

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 小丸子發覺世上有很多相似，但實際上是不一樣的東西之後，開始關注這類東西。小丸子與媽媽約定，一起努力收緊生活態度。小丸子要不再懶洋洋，過有規律的生活。而媽媽則是要不貪吃，減肥瘦身。

programme.title: 潛行天下粵
programme.desc: 《潛行天下》以全球海洋為主題，採用8K超高清攝影機和水下無人機等技術建構沉浸式觀影體驗，跨越四大洋14國水域拍攝，記錄雙髻鯊、鯨鯊等海洋生物活動，探密三沙永樂龍洞等特殊地形。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 新聞透視粵
programme.desc: 政府預計今個財年，代表日常開支的經營帳目可以恢復盈餘。面對數年財赤，除了發債，今屆政府合共轉撥了數千億元基金款項到政府一般收入帳目，應付日常開支，這些財政手段是能真的有助改善財赤？基本法規定特區政府要量入為出，但政府開支年年攀升，大幅超過庫房收入，長遠如何維持政府財政健康？

programme.title: 好嘢港多啲粵
programme.desc: 香港特區政府帶領各個部門及單位，適時推出不同的政策措施，為本港市民、到訪旅客、來自外地的投資者提供便捷服務。香港這麼好，當然要多說一些讓大家知道。《好嘢港多啲》以輕鬆有趣的拍攝手法，配合陳豪、高海寧、張振朗、劉佩玥、周嘉洛、羅子溢、馬國明、陳懿德、陳展鵬、劉穎鏇等一眾星級藝員，透過不同角色、形象，生動地表達香港的各樣美好和優勢。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: K Cash業主私人貸款呈獻 :香港系列之細間始終你好粵
programme.desc: 舖頭可以有幾細？「善用」唐樓的樓梯底位置，已可做生意。負責補鞋、配匙、開鎖的店主，一直保持身型，以求於狹窄的空間行動自如，但那裡其實還有很多「偷位」之處？祥師兄駕車到已光顧逾廿年的大牌檔，與第二代老闆在飯桌聚舊，老闆身體勞損仍堅持做足365日，做好雞粥、乳鴿、炒麵！偕著名武指林迪安同往土瓜灣，地下醫館、天台武館，分別由兩姊弟主理，最重要是承傳父親心血，有武術徒弟笑言師父「戇居」，只因一個窩心舉動？

programme.title: AlipayHK 呈獻:唱錢粵
programme.desc: 音準、拍子大考驗，唱歌隨時有錢落袋！曾為家人放棄追夢的居港台灣人、只為在TVB化一次妝的媽媽級挑戰者，分別接受《唱錢》洗禮，透過挑戰Sing盤上不同歌曲難度「過三關」，甚至是最難的Monster關卡，向掃清九宮格的目標進發。觀眾只需用手機掃描螢幕上的QR Code，即可參與直播室互動，為挑戰者打氣，更有機會贏取福利。

programme.title: J Music粵
programme.desc: 林曉培亮相節目獻唱新歌<她的眼淚之餘，並與主持冼靖峰合唱<煩。她將在港舉行個唱，還想過將廣東歌放入歌單？「偶像零距離」詹天文回答粉絲提問，粉絲甚麼舉動曾令她大為感動？天文現場演繹<在十字路口告別，作為回饋。涂毓麟與好友韋諾合寫<善良或染的曲詞，箇中的「染」所指為何？兩人還分享特別創作習慣。這集亦會倒數「勁歌金榜」，還有新晉六人男團ALITZ介紹團名背後意義。甫出道就推出專輯又有甚麼用意？

programme.title: 風味人間 第2季粵
programme.desc: 地球上的蟹種繁多，幻化出無窮滋味。來自冰冷海域的帝王蟹，捕撈難度高，挪威不少漁民被其鮮甜味道吸引，每年冒險出海。山林間亦可尋到蟹蹤，雲南山區溪流的山螃蟹，當地人搗碎製醬，成為佐飯佳餚。甘香可口的大閘蟹深受饕客喜愛，未成年就上市的六月黃被視為滋味前菜。威尼斯人窺準於艾氏濱蟹退殼後捕捉，炸成可整隻放入口的軟殼蟹。珠江流域的青蟹，不同成長階段各具風味，當中以黃油蟹最為矜貴，全身滲透甘甜的黃油，令人回味。

programme.title: J Sport粵
programme.desc: 花劍越來越流行，主持一探比賽規則，並投入試玩，感受劍擊魅力。全接觸空手道允許直接擊打對方，賽制上與傳統空手道有甚麼分別？藝人關楚耀迷上匹克球，積極參賽、考教練牌，還推廣這項新興運動。甲一籃球總決賽第二場，滿貫力求反撲，香港東方又能否乘勝追擊？此外，晉裕男籃走進社區跟街坊拜年。啟德體育園開幕一周年，前港將出席運動體驗日與眾同樂。港隊主場出戰U18男子冰球世錦賽，表現如何？另帶來香港摔跤錦標賽戰報。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵 及 天氣報告粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 財經透視粵
programme.desc: 人形機械人應用逐漸落地，要分析這類AI下游產業鏈的股份時，要留意甚麼？人大政協兩會召開，適逢今年亦是「十五五」規劃開局之年，會議會如何為中國經濟走向定調？

programme.title: 叠影狙擊#5粵PG
programme.desc: 文諾帶晟杰找文雅卻被趕走，晟杰潛入Green World密室遇黑衣人，懷疑是梁曦。Tina燒毀密室證據，晟杰突然來到…曉晨逼問忠仔怎麼虐待文雅，又說服Tina讓晟杰介入調查利民。文諾親自試探，曉晨得知文諾做過心臟移植…

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 港產旅行團粵PG
programme.desc: 牛年新春，衍峰、祖儀、穎彤前往昂坪棧道行大運！無限踏步棧道梯級，運動盲穎彤可會應付得來？考驗未完，三人還要挑戰離地驚險步道！完成辛苦的棧道行程，在昂坪市集品嚐港式小吃，不忘到心經簡林洗滌心靈。Ben Sir、淑雅、衍峰實測本地盆菜團，尋覓流水響「天空之鏡」秘境，還有屏山盆菜等着餵飽三人！接着親親羊駝、壁畫村內感受藝術氣息、紅磚屋市集買手信，好圓滿。嘉賓馬貫東帶祖儀到馬灣荒廢舊村打卡，拍出頹廢美感。

programme.title: 周六聊Teen谷粵
programme.desc: 德國於二戰後分裂為東德與西德，由美、英、法、蘇四國分別管理。由於理念各異，民眾生活截然不同，令當時不少東德人希望逃往西德，東德當局遂下令建造柏林圍牆。谷主凱婷講述這段歷史，還展示了柏林圍牆逃亡路線的模擬圖。眾谷們又討論柏林圍牆倒下的原因，汛文、泳嘉猜測是於德國統一後才發生，已作資料搜集的凱婷卻指拍檔倒轉了因果，何出此言？泳嘉曾到訪柏林圍牆，更與著名塗鴉《兄弟之吻》打卡，該幅圖畫的由來又是怎樣？

programme.title: 仨心友行粵
programme.desc: 位於塔崑山附近的住宅，被大片林木與河流包圍，十足世外桃園。「閨密睇樓團」先後參觀復古風、度假風的別墅，敏之還獲高Ling、嘉欣奉上四手按摩，好寫意。高Ling離隊返港途中，打開姊妹們準備的愛心便當，更覺感動！另邊廂，陳凱琳飛抵哥打峇魯會合敏之，隨即到舊式茶室醫肚。道北有「小泰國」之稱，兩位人母試坐地道火車，並交流養兒經。見識過當地最大的坐佛像後，二人化身布藝學徒，投入繪畫、上色步驟，壓力一掃而空。

programme.title: 成人教科書粵
programme.desc: 生與死是每個人都要面對、經歷的人生課題，洪永城要四位小朋友填寫死亡證，想像自己的死亡日期、地點、死因等，有女生笑言會因太富有而招致殺身之禍？小朋友如掌握生殺大權，哪些相中生命可殺？哪些不可殺？問到會否吃豬肉時，有人自稱不會殺豬，但別人殺了卻會吃。節目組還會讓一名十一歲女生籌辦生前派對，並邀請其家人、親友出席。主角女孩因父母在台上的分享而感觸，參與活動的洪永城及其他小朋友又有甚麼難忘感受？

programme.title: 手匠傳承粵韓
programme.desc: 吳哥金屬工藝是柬埔寨特別的藝術品，本集將會講述製作過程及其背後意義。印度教神話故事對柬埔寨藝術的影響十分深遠, 工匠把故事刻在工藝品上, 希望可以讓故事繼續流傳, 並延續祖先文化的傳統

programme.title: 隆行天下之重走八千里路雲和月普
粵講粵㜺鬼粵
programme.desc: 元宵佳節，三位主持聯同「主婦look」示人的黃建東，闖進銅鑼灣鬧市應節，測試市民對男、女有關歇後語的認識。麥美恩、吳幸美被大學講師廖舜禧問到「拍拖」出處、「氹」字的正寫，可有獨到見解？俗語「三七二十一」出於戰國時代？且聽舜禧溯本尋源。主持們及後到訪鏡畫舖、磁廠及糖水店，又何以搬出「強盜照鏡」、「豬乸噍田螺」、「竹織鴨」等歇後語？「酸薑竹」比喻玩弄女士的男子，鄭寶鴻淺談當中歷史掌故。

programme.title: 粵講粵㜺鬼粵
programme.desc: 美恩、幸美和茶餐廳老闆有個約會，探究「大髀痛」、「和尚跳海」，以及「打荷」等茶餐廳、食店廚房術語的奧妙。大學講師廖舜禧細談歷史人物歇後語，還講解「茅根竹」等「縮腳歇後語」特色、奄尖的「奄」與打尖的「尖」本字，及「一蚊雞」（一元）出處。「北角夜總會」形容別人經常遲到，掌故專家鄭寶鴻趣談這間娛樂場所的威水史！主持們又到訪文具展覽館與繡花鞋店，實地活用「甩頭筆」、「繡花姑娘打架」等相關歇後語，格外傳神！

programme.title: 大玩特玩粵
programme.desc: 下白泥是野餐好地點，今集遊戲全部與食物有關。首次參與遊戲的蝦頭，飢餓得要用「泰山壓頂」招數來吃懸在對手頭上的食物，哪位男藝員被寵幸？舉手可招來侍應，舉腳才可進食是甚麼玩法？藝員出醜食相盡呈現！野餐不能缺少三文治，再加上綠色醬料，一場wasabi災難又上演……Bob發揮「神預測」本色，換來全部人員最期待的大懲罰！遊戲盡顯特玩隊的人性醜惡，但天意卻讓他們出線爭獎品，「輸家」連詩雅竟有出頭天！

programme.title: 熊貓一家人粵普
programme.desc: 實習生的新一個實習課頭是有機會前往神樹坪繁育園或都江堰康養區，他們剛好有機會見證熊貓寶寶誕生的一刻；站長給他們介紹怎樣照顧大熊貓生產前的起居飲食；另一位飼養員則給他們介紹怎樣照顧初生熊貓寶寶。

programme.title: 星夢頻道粵日
programme.desc: 未來、繪萌、凜花、安娜、莎拉、玫兒，還有瑪莉亞、鈴、杏樹、虹之咲合共十位寶石偶像，卻只有一人能被選為鑽石偶像的寶石時裝大賽終於開始。繪萌與安娜順利表演過後，面對觀眾與競爭的壓力，竟令凜花感到不安……

programme.title: 多啦A夢粵
programme.desc: 大雄見家裡經濟財政緊絀，於是走去尋寶，多啦A夢知道後借他「尋寶機」和「飄浮噴霧」。大雄不小心害靜香的胸針掉進水塘，用過法寶「加醋減醋」後心生一計，但在前往水塘的路上遭遇諸多阻撓。

programme.title: B-PROJECT超星團粵日
programme.desc: 在翼的努力之下，Ultras的工作漸上軌道，但A太卻因為一次誤會而抱怨翼把B-PROJECT放在優先，本身對Ultras頗有微詞的剛士因而與A太發生衝突，詎料此時公司卻下令要B-PROJECT發展YourTube，理想做法自然是請教精於此道的Ultras。

programme.title: 魔都女行粵
programme.desc: 發掘「魔都」隱世美食，來到地道麵館，婭溦、糖妹按照網上排名點菜，蛤蜊豬肝拌麵、茄盒、腰花辣肉湯麵，果真名不虛傳。光顧傳聞「怪脾氣」師傅蛋糕店、古早味冰糕與人氣脆香鮮肉月餅，風味小吃滋味連連。主持們被「古董花園」復古氛圍吸引，優雅地淺嚐美式鬆餅與造型蛋糕。接着遊逛老上海歐式風格小區，先打卡再覓食。入黑，味蕾試試新口味，主打越南粉的東南亞餐廳，可會是兩位主持杯茶？酒吧內的雞尾酒名字趣怪，越夜越精彩！

programme.title: 食好D 食平D粵
programme.desc: 肥媽向來注重固本培元，並以簡單食材製作多款養顏美食，從內到外散發健康風采。莙薘菜又名「豬乸菜」，外表平凡卻含豐富營養。以莙薘菜及多種蔬菜做成的上素卷，質感爽脆口味清新，更是都市人的減壓珍品。炮製「花生眉豆螺頭雞腳湯」要選用「老母雞」，到底有何特別功效？另一佳餚以「自然豬腩片」配上有助抗衰老的紫淮山、鮮百合，刁鑽選材全為吃得更安心。同場加映「秘製蜜汁燒焗豬肋條」，藉着啖啖肉滋味，滿足6號的肉食喜好。

programme.title: 食好D 食平D粵
programme.desc: 不同產地的木瓜，質感、甜度各有分別，肥媽和6號往果欄逐一介紹，並為是日「泰好味」餐單搜羅食材。青木瓜沙律拌入豆豉鯪魚，帶來嶄新口感；6號大受刺激，竟模仿阿媽唱腔！用自家製青咖喱醬煮出的「青咖喱雞」，則是「送飯」佳餚。「泰式魚露鳳爪」以檸檬、青檸、白醋等混合的酸汁浸醃，味道層次豐富。期間6號鳳爪、雞腳不分，又提起無骨鳳爪的都市傳聞，被阿媽直斥無知！此外，要令「冬蔭功」內的蝦肉爽口不霉，肥媽有何秘訣？

programme.title: 少年中醫說粵普
programme.desc: 節目聚焦於青年族群體驗中醫藥文化，集結中國七所中醫藥的7名高校學子，在主持人和中醫藥名家的帶領下，探尋中華醫聖故裡，以「盲盒路線分組體驗」醫聖故裡的形式，了解醫聖對當代中醫藥發展的啟示。

programme.title: 約埋班Friend去旅行粵PG
programme.desc: 四人到清邁郊外等待看日出，並訴說相關經歷。和嘉洛同往看日出許願竟是兩男？JW最有記憶的日出，是與吳業坤一起拍劇。畏高的JW鼓起勇氣試玩動力滑翔傘，降落即要求擁抱互勉。登艇遊河兼食船麵，甚麼令陳瀅眼濕濕？走進市場，大家開始試吃之行，JW獻出食榴槤第一次。主持們換上民族服，邊品嚐地道美食邊欣賞民族表演。四人分組在周末市集買食物開餐，同時考驗另類默契。挑戰叢林間的過山車與飛索，JW能否再次戰勝恐懼？

programme.title: 約埋班Friend去旅行粵PG
programme.desc: 深入清邁鄉村逛小店，朱仔竟踴躍發言，拍檔都配合地轉為「靜音模式」。朱仔更挑戰JW底線要其吃蜜蜂蛋，嚇得她落荒而逃！四人分享清邁之旅難忘點滴，有人講到喊，更發覺此行絕對不容嘉洛缺席！大家還透過收到的禮物，競猜自己的「秘密天使」……張振朗、賴慰玲接力出發，辦理飛澳洲的登機手續之際，朱仔驚喜送機，卻是「計中計」，他會乘坐航班的商務位同行。站在海水中央食蠔，可有特別感受？不過，振朗的熟練開蠔技術才是焦點！

programme.title: 甜心先生粵
programme.desc: 很多父母都有一套取悅兒女的「殺手鐧」，好爸爸李忠希了解兩歲半囡囡最愛甜食，因此經常炮製簡單甜品，讓女兒透過味蕾品嚐父親對她的關愛。泡芙製作過程看似簡單，但不少朋友在家中試做時卻不知從何入手。「甜品達人」古嘉俊就跟大家分享心得，示範一款口感和味道皆與眾不同的「椰子杏仁泡芙」。以牛油曲奇配搭外脆內軟的泡芙，創意十足。泡芙外層換上黃糖製成的酥皮，造型彷如港式菠蘿包，箇中構思是否與忠希最愛懷舊甜品有關？

programme.title: 新幹線戰士 改變世界粵日
programme.desc: 東海總部出現天才駕駛員，憑一人之力便戰勝UNKNOWN。太晴等人前往名古屋拜會該駕駛員，得知對方叫魚虎天，年紀更少於他們。良太和茜就天的事情發生爭執，天的適性值卻在訓練中突然急遽下降。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 熱愛一件事情，努力去做，一定會有好成績。這回「My Little Show」的兩位表演者，湊巧都是帶來舞蹈演出。想成就一段優美的舞步，相信都曾下過不少苦功，更要克服種種困難，一同看看二人如何藉舞蹈展現自信與活力。很多歌曲都陪着我們成長，寫下了青春印記，彤彤姐姐、玲玲姐姐分別細談小時候喜愛的歌曲與夢想。兩人還在結他導師的伴奏下，一起合唱<青春頌和<一生何求，唱歌的同時，也可細味歌詞中的人生哲理。

programme.title: 屁屁偵探粵日
programme.desc: 人氣偶像姜姜主演的電影片場收到怪盜M的犯罪預告，說要偷走傳說中的寶刀玻璃丸，屁屁偵探應小鈴請求去到片場，眾人在導演安排下參與電影拍攝，屁屁偵探揭破姜姜的經理人扁口魚是怪盜M假冒。

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 宏志嚮往鄉郊生活，但遭到媽媽反對，適逢鄉郊有人賣屋，宏志於是帶同小丸子和爺爺去看屋。老人會舉行馬拉松比賽，詎料未開始已有過半數人棄權，為了吸引家人參加，友藏訛稱比賽有豐富獎品。

programme.title: 好嘢港多啲粵
programme.desc: 香港特區政府帶領各個部門及單位，適時推出不同的政策措施，為本港市民、到訪旅客、來自外地的投資者提供便捷服務。香港這麼好，當然要多說一些讓大家知道。《好嘢港多啲》以輕鬆有趣的拍攝手法，配合陳豪、高海寧、張振朗、劉佩玥、周嘉洛、羅子溢、馬國明、陳懿德、陳展鵬、劉穎鏇等一眾星級藝員，透過不同角色、形象，生動地表達香港的各樣美好和優勢。

programme.title: 潛行天下粵

programme.title: 星期日檔案粵
programme.desc: 中國人愛金，根據世界黃金協會統計，2024年中國人的黃金購買量連續12年位居世界第一。地緣政局不穩，黃金作為資金避難所，價格創下歷史新高，升穿5,500美元一盎司。有業內人士指，現正經歷「黃金大時代」。而白銀亦追落後，兩者價格大幅波動。金銀價格大起大跌，對業內人士有何衝擊? 又如何應對呢？

programme.title: 警聲百二秒 III粵

programme.desc: 導師分組賽繼續上演，紅隊布志綸、紫隊高少華、綠隊張嘉銘三大導師帶領下，舉行三個回合的合唱比拼，各隊代表組合分別演繹Beyond樂隊、王菲、林憶蓮的作品。這集最低分的隊伍，會有兩人被淘汰。

programme.title: 一周星星粵
programme.desc: 太極樂隊加入樂壇40年，成軍是更久的日子，如何維繫友誼？「你問我答」有歌手卻疑似目睹他們曾黑面吵架，事實又是如何？泳兒的提問，竟令劉賢德被指有所偏心！訪談其間，朱翰博突然自稱「萬能插蘇」，這別名因何得來？也講起某成員的投資之道，不論是照相機鏡頭還是身邊伴侶，都穩有盈餘？入行40周年演唱會，可準備了甚麼驚喜？太極還會在螢幕前演繹<紅色跑車、<留住我吧、<全人類高歌等金曲，讓樂迷們先聽為快！

programme.title: 美食新聞周報粵
programme.desc: 胡美貽與鼎爺品嚐古法粵菜，包括鮮味十足的鷓鴣粥、工序繁複的雞子戈渣，以及肉嫩多汁的黑松露手撕炸子雞，令人回味無窮。伍倩彤走訪上環的排隊熱店，遍嚐充滿創意的特脆菠蘿包、氮氣奶茶及韓式炸雞意式三文治，滋味獨特。胡美貽再駕車載廖慧儀前往大美督，到訪慧儀推介的隱世台式餐廳，試吃滿漢三寶牛肉麵、麻辣鴨血冬粉，風味正宗。Agnes則帶施焯日細嚐新派精緻福建菜，永春老醋海蜇凍酸香濃郁、紅蟳糯米飯鮮味「爆燈」！

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 叠影狙擊#6粵PG
programme.desc: 晟杰質問曉晨為何出現在密室中，曉晨自知瞞不住，只好帶晟杰到飛飛家，但去到後發現飛飛已被發哥抓走。曉晨和晟杰趕到貨倉贖飛飛之時，遇上霆釗及其手下，曉晨展現出她的好身手，並開槍擊斃殺手，令晟杰感到詫異。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 少年中醫說粵普
programme.desc: 節目聚焦於青年族群體驗中醫藥文化，集結中國七所中醫藥的7名高校學子，在主持人和中醫藥名家的帶領下，探尋中華醫聖故裡，以「盲盒路線分組體驗」醫聖故裡的形式，了解醫聖對當代中醫藥發展的啟示。

programme.title: 約埋班Friend去旅行粵
programme.desc: 眾星戲癮發作，合演特工小劇場，旨在介紹逾百年歷史的特工主題餐廳。桌上甫見到豬肉的肥膏，朱仔隨即想起陳瀅？深入文創藝術村買手信，女生盡顯默契；四人更一起DIY手繩，陳瀅卻嫌JW破壞文青氣氛？走進聚集年輕人的市集，陳瀅獲飾品店主贈送禮物，令嘉洛要向店主問明原因！店主的熱情舉動反讓陳瀅歉疚，她即為三名拍檔買禮物，卻差點因為一隻卡通玩偶激怒朱仔？去泰國梗要按摩！兩女久候嘉洛、朱仔，要化身按摩女郎戲弄他們！

programme.title: 約埋班Friend去旅行粵
programme.desc: 眾主持登上雙龍寺參拜，順道俯瞰清邁市風景。來到小孩遊樂場，嘉洛童心大發，陳瀅勉強陪玩，JW自認老了？兩男試玩人造沖浪卻跌不停，嘉洛還遇上小意外，引來女拍檔們追究？邊吃邊聊，JW揭露陳瀅曾致電向她哭訴。泰式餐廳設有一個園林美景，眾人彷如置身於仙境中用餐。怎料嘉洛餐後大意遺下銀包，被陳瀅手抓到報復機會……入夜返回酒店，大家齊集玩問答遊戲。一條誰人最有義氣的問題，陳瀅的答案卻令兩男傷心「中箭」？

programme.title: 甜心先生粵
programme.desc: 很多父母都有一套取悅兒女的「殺手鐧」，好爸爸李忠希了解兩歲半囡囡最愛甜食，因此經常炮製簡單甜品，讓女兒透過味蕾品嚐父親對她的關愛。泡芙製作過程看似簡單，但不少朋友在家中試做時卻不知從何入手。「甜品達人」古嘉俊就跟大家分享心得，示範一款口感和味道皆與眾不同的「椰子杏仁泡芙」。以牛油曲奇配搭外脆內軟的泡芙，創意十足。泡芙外層換上黃糖製成的酥皮，造型彷如港式菠蘿包，箇中構思是否與忠希最愛懷舊甜品有關？

programme.title: 魔都女行粵
programme.desc: 發掘「魔都」隱世美食，來到地道麵館，婭溦、糖妹按照網上排名點菜，蛤蜊豬肝拌麵、茄盒、腰花辣肉湯麵，果真名不虛傳。光顧傳聞「怪脾氣」師傅蛋糕店、古早味冰糕與人氣脆香鮮肉月餅，風味小吃滋味連連。主持們被「古董花園」復古氛圍吸引，優雅地淺嚐美式鬆餅與造型蛋糕。接着遊逛老上海歐式風格小區，先打卡再覓食。入黑，味蕾試試新口味，主打越南粉的東南亞餐廳，可會是兩位主持杯茶？酒吧內的雞尾酒名字趣怪，越夜越精彩！

programme.title: 食好D 食平D粵
programme.desc: 肥媽向來注重固本培元，並以簡單食材製作多款養顏美食，從內到外散發健康風采。莙薘菜又名「豬乸菜」，外表平凡卻含豐富營養。以莙薘菜及多種蔬菜做成的上素卷，質感爽脆口味清新，更是都市人的減壓珍品。炮製「花生眉豆螺頭雞腳湯」要選用「老母雞」，到底有何特別功效？另一佳餚以「自然豬腩片」配上有助抗衰老的紫淮山、鮮百合，刁鑽選材全為吃得更安心。同場加映「秘製蜜汁燒焗豬肋條」，藉着啖啖肉滋味，滿足6號的肉食喜好。

programme.title: 熊貓一家人粵普
programme.desc: 實習生的新一個實習課頭是有機會前往神樹坪繁育園或都江堰康養區，他們剛好有機會見證熊貓寶寶誕生的一刻；站長給他們介紹怎樣照顧大熊貓生產前的起居飲食；另一位飼養員則給他們介紹怎樣照顧初生熊貓寶寶。

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵

高朋滿座#49粵
programme.desc: 娜訛稱身患絕症，義對她千依百順，她更入住高家，但娜妒忌義與家人融洽，竟戲弄義替她買消夜。義巧遇家敏，得悉她剛與男友分手，卻因自己已有女友而傷心。情被指破壞家中秩序，但憑滿的閉路電視中，揭發原是娜所為。

programme.title: 天龍八部#22粵普PG
programme.desc: 三十六洞、七十二島主以烏老大為首，打算與慕容復、語嫣及段譽聯手，討伐天山童姥，但沒有人知道她的真實容貌。烏老大在山上抓到一個小女孩，以為是靈鷲宮的人，打算殺了她，虛竹及時出手相救，原來她正是天山童姥。

programme.title: 交易現場粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 除夕夜，鼎爺炮製足以令人飽肚的「裹蒸糉」，選葉選料都特別有要求，還要好好學習如何紮糭，以及預備整天為五花腩醃味。吃過糭，阿譚憶起端午節到順德古朗村跟村民一起包糉，並參與起龍儀式與千人龍船飯的熱鬧情況！香港地方細，絕少本土走地雞，但仍有自家培養雞種。鼎爺分享揀靚雞秘訣之餘，還切好薑絲、蔥絲，做出一碟「蔥油少爺雞」，甚麼方法可令雞皮更爽脆？鼎爺再煮一道「麻婆豆腐」滿足阿譚的食慾，但桌面竟見脢頭牛肉？

programme.title: 保誠保險呈獻：AI時代，讓子女世界放大粵
流行都市粵
programme.desc: 《流行都市》為觀眾介紹時令產品、健康養生、健體運動、護膚化妝、時尚服飾、嬰幼兒護理、育兒知識、城中美食、飼養寵物等潮流資訊，內容包羅萬有！主持們親身體驗、示範或測試之外，還會邀請嘉賓帶來相關專業知識。烹飪環節方面，多位手勢了得的廚藝專家輪流登場，示範簡單美味的健康美食、家常小菜，替大家解決煮食煩惱。

programme.title: 一條麻甩在東莞粵
programme.desc: 大部份城市都有一條老街，而莞城區街道可謂「老東莞」的靈魂。本集，祖藍引領大家尋找藏在騎樓底下的地道美食，首先要試最出名的燒鵝瀨，一探東莞燒鵝瀨聲名遠揚的原因，而臘味、小吃、甜品當然都缺一不可。食飽再逛一逛老街，感受彷彿凝固於舊時的人情味……

programme.title: 燦爛的外母#1粵PG
programme.desc: 蕭秀瓊得知豆腐師傅入醫院，立即驅車返廠幫忙生產豆腐。王兆明服侍大富豪華少妥妥貼貼，但仍被罵得狗血淋頭。秀瓊得知老闆傅德正私會小三，走入單位捉姦時只見兆明在屋內。德正兒子竇彰學成歸來，在豆品廠從頭學起。竇彰有意投資黃豆期貨，秀瓊不贊成。華少和楊老闆在慶功宴上逼使兆明脫褲，兆明毅然辭職。兆明知道竇彰有意改革家族豆品生意，主動為竇彰寫建議書。兆明不滿曉盈向華少求情；曉盈和兆明分手，竟將扭蛋機轉送司徒嵐。

programme.title: 偶像星願7 Third BEAT!粵日
programme.desc: 阿百收留了出走的一織和三月，大和則獲得阿千收留。凪透露自己被人跟蹤，故要加強保安。眾人寂寞難耐，阿陸打電話給一織望和好，卻吵架收場。大和受不住阿千的言語刺激，終於說出自己的心聲。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 兒童節目《Hands Up》有「醬汁家族」成員和一眾主持，陪伴大家度��愉快時光。「Kids’ Notes」邀請不同界別人士，跟小朋友分享有趣事物；透過「勇闖小兵團」遊戲，讓孩子們快樂遊玩；運動教練引領大家「Workout 2gether」，鍛練身體；還會透過「Artspiration」，引領孩子了解藝術世界；「My Little Show」開放表演舞台，小朋友到來盡情展示才藝！

programme.title: 多啦A夢粵
programme.desc: 大雄趕著回家做功課，卻被棒球打中，一氣之下把球亂丟，打破了神成家的玻璃，結果遭全鎮通緝。小夫把父母的舊衣重新穿搭，大雄要與他進行穿搭對決，多啦A夢用「時光熱線」與未來商店直接溝通。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.desc: 樓市回穩，銀主盤消化速度也加快，九龍塘一個自製複式，叫價折讓有多少？

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2759粵
programme.desc: Bonnie被某位新演員稱呼為「Bonnie姐」，杜演趁機鼓動眾人一同以此尊稱她，甚至在片場外亦以「姐」相稱。Bonnie地位提升，帶來不少好處，起初樂於被稱作「Bonnie姐」，後來卻發現不少問題，城安遂向她提議「去姐化」的方法。Bonnie照辦後成效顯著，凌凌卻認為不妥。另一方面，該名新演員突然「爆紅」，變得十分囂張，Bonnie嘗試藉着杜演來整治此人，杜演卻惹上極大麻煩……

programme.title: X Wallet呈獻:臥底嬌娃#11粵PG
programme.desc: 楚渝向步青及奕風當面問責，幸得步青替奕風出面解釋。小茹之母佩琳和歐凱的婆婆Helen偶然相認；Helen心生妙計以增加小茹和歐凱日後的相處機會。歐凱也終於踏出勇敢的第一步，向小茹提出約會。索帕盯上寶儀，似乎心懷不軌。寶儀上法文班時認識了鄰座的同學，那人竟是索帕！奕風為免牽涉妙姿的感情風波而使她尷尬，決定透過佳琪來開解妙姿；妙姿向佳琪坦白與瀚東的往事……索帕帶寶儀出走，更成功擺脫妙姿。

programme.title: Funki Finance 呈獻：機智女法醫2#3粵普PG
programme.desc: 石青為了保護其他宮女，不願意說出真相，直到行刑時，柳兒她們趕過來說有證據，最後瑾瑜命人重審。南趙二王子祐辰安避過連番刺殺，終於抵達大唐，瑾瑜和楚楚負責接待，卻發現他身受重傷，所以將他秘密安置在三法司。

programme.title: 中國建設銀行(亞洲)呈獻：攻你上大學粵
programme.desc: 提出分手有學問，七位「中學生」僅一人答錯，莫非都是經驗之談？大學階段，公關危機是藝人關心議題，「女神」縱答錯「黃金24小時」，仍有所得着。哲學題令四人一臉苦惱，識玩當然指定他人答！物理學「量子糾纏」同樣難以應付，「優異生」善用錦囊反彈題目，及後卻被連環集火，生物學、風險管理科學範疇可如何拆招？兩強一題定勝負，「系統理論」重點在於「系統」……大四問題與「畢業生」的主修科有關，「獎學金」似乎十拿九穩？

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 天氣報告粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
康業信貸快遞呈獻：尋秦記#19粵
programme.desc: 少龍與趙盤到牛家村找嬴政，豈料只見靈位。朱姬看到手持白玉戒指的趙盤，誤以為他是嬴政，少龍決定將錯就錯，分別對應元及趙盤痛陳利害，眾無奈贊同。善柔從墨者周平手中救出呆滯試藥女子，竟是廷芳。廷芳欲自盡，善柔透露少龍悔婚有苦衷，廷芳思念少龍。善柔與廷芳到達秦境，巧遇少龍等，廷芳心頭激動，隨即黯然離去。少龍要趙盤忘記真正身分，以後是嬴政。呂不韋出城迎接朱姬與嬴政，人群中連晉聽到朱姬叫趙盤做王子政感錯愕。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 《流行都市》為觀眾介紹時令產品、健康養生、健體運動、護膚化妝、時尚服飾、嬰幼兒護理、育兒知識、城中美食、飼養寵物等潮流資訊，內容包羅萬有！主持們親身體驗、示範或測試之外，還會邀請嘉賓帶來相關專業知識。烹飪環節方面，多位手勢了得的廚藝專家輪流登場，示範簡單美味的健康美食、家常小菜，替大家解決煮食煩惱。

programme.title: 一條麻甩在東莞粵
programme.desc: 大部份城市都有一條老街，而莞城區街道可謂「老東莞」的靈魂。本集，祖藍引領大家尋找藏在騎樓底下的地道美食，首先要試最出名的燒鵝瀨，一探東莞燒鵝瀨聲名遠揚的原因，而臘味、小吃、甜品當然都缺一不可。食飽再逛一逛老街，感受彷彿凝固於舊時的人情味……

programme.title: 燦爛的外母#1粵PG
programme.desc: 蕭秀瓊得知豆腐師傅入醫院，立即驅車返廠幫忙生產豆腐。王兆明服侍大富豪華少妥妥貼貼，但仍被罵得狗血淋頭。秀瓊得知老闆傅德正私會小三，走入單位捉姦時只見兆明在屋內。德正兒子竇彰學成歸來，在豆品廠從頭學起。竇彰有意投資黃豆期貨，秀瓊不贊成。華少和楊老闆在慶功宴上逼使兆明脫褲，兆明毅然辭職。兆明知道竇彰有意改革家族豆品生意，主動為竇彰寫建議書。兆明不滿曉盈向華少求情；曉盈和兆明分手，竟將扭蛋機轉送司徒嵐。

programme.title: 高朋滿座#49粵
programme.desc: 娜訛稱身患絕症，義對她千依百順，她更入住高家，但娜妒忌義與家人融洽，竟戲弄義替她買消夜。義巧遇家敏，得悉她剛與男友分手，卻因自己已有女友而傷心。情被指破壞家中秩序，但憑滿的閉路電視中，揭發原是娜所為。

programme.title: 天龍八部#22粵普PG
programme.desc: 三十六洞、七十二島主以烏老大為首，打算與慕容復、語嫣及段譽聯手，討伐天山童姥，但沒有人知道她的真實容貌。烏老大在山上抓到一個小女孩，以為是靈鷲宮的人，打算殺了她，虛竹及時出手相救，原來她正是天山童姥。

programme.title: 紳士與小姐
programme.desc: 【韓國收視破38%韓版《真善美》重拾幸福時光】《我唯一的守護者》編劇金始慶最新家庭劇新作，與爸爸、繼母一同生活的直率女孩朴丹丹，因繼兄繼母闖禍被詐騙，使得原本不富裕的家庭更加困苦，面對爸爸的偏坦對待，朴丹丹憤而離家，因緣際會下來到有錢人家擔任住宿教師，陪伴失去母親的三個孩子，而他們的爸爸便是高冷霸道總裁李英國，在妻子早逝後，英國的內心漸漸封閉，與孩子間也產生隔閡，好在天真浪漫的朴丹丹出現，加上孩子們的湊合，幸福將再次降臨。

programme.title: 家宴
programme.desc: 【離家追夢，還是回家團圓？馮家菜北漂生存戰】馮家菜是北京頗具名氣的淮揚菜館，女強人大米憑藉一身拼勁，將小館打造成金字招牌，卻因妹夫欠債，陷入食品安全風波，生意一落千丈。為救餐館，她請出退休父親參賽，奪得全國冠軍，卻招來資本大鱷周路的覬覦。親情與利益交織，事業與愛情碰撞，兄妹間信任破裂，馮家菜面臨生死存亡。當大米病倒，家庭崩解，弟弟豆子終於悔悟，全家攜手重建家業。當揚州炒飯再次上桌，家的味道，未曾改變。

programme.title: 生活家
programme.desc: 【金馬演員攜手演出破產母女生存記】少見的審計職場劇，樂觀正向，帶給人心激勵。從小在拮据家庭成長的邱冬娜，在課業工作上總是特別勤奮，希望透過自己的努力讓母親過上好生活。畢業後，因緣際會下進入了前輩顧飛開的審計稽核公司，面對孤僻但能力強的主管顧飛，邱冬娜雖然頭痛但絕不認輸！運用從母親身上學到的智慧，還有艱困生活帶給她的精打細算體質，邱冬娜總能屢出奇招化解艱難任務。曾有心理創傷的主管顧飛，也在邱冬娜的陪伴下，兩人亦師亦友,相互扶持鼓勵，逐漸治癒傷口，成為彼此的靈魂伴侶。

programme.title: 兩個女人的房間
programme.desc: 【慘遭閨蜜心機暗算朴恩惠由飯店繼承人淪為女僕】在瑞士留學歸來後，晴彩充滿自信地踏入了蒙娜麗莎飯店，端莊秀麗的外表和聰穎的頭腦，讓她很快成為了飯店的副社長兼繼承人。與同飯店的總經理志燮之間的戀情，更是讓她的生活充滿了甜蜜和期待。一場車禍意外將掀起腥風血雨，當晴彩以為自己撞死了熙秀的養父時，內心充滿了恐懼與內疚感，在晴彩的堅持下，熙秀搬進了她的家，開始了新的生活。從那時起，晴彩心愛的人和她的一切都逐漸被熙秀所奪走，包括飯店的地位和財富，晴彩更是從繼承人淪為女僕，為了奪回曾經的一切，晴彩將對熙秀展開復仇。

programme.title: 我的野蠻王妃
programme.desc: 【神級經典韓劇，尹恩惠、朱智勳、金楨勳、宋智孝再現現代宮廷指腹為婚！！】申采靜原本只是一名平凡無奇的高中學生，得知爺爺的遺囑中，她與皇太子李信有婚約在身。因家中債務的原因，在無可奈何的情況完婚。待在皇室的申采靜對宮內生活十分反彈，此時海歸回來的皇位第二繼承者李律及李信前女友閔孝琳的存在，展開錯綜複雜的故事。

programme.title: 另一種藍
programme.desc: 【宋茜邂逅周渝民，事業失意返鄉傳承青花瓷再現風華！！】北漂少女陳小滿努力工作、省吃儉用為求入股家族瓷器事業，卻以失敗收場，毅然決然回景德鎮專心學習瓷器工藝。陳小滿工作的上司柯巖則在投資上遭遇前所未有的失利，輾轉來到景德鎮。處於低潮的兩人在互相治癒中重新找回站起來的力量，事業重新起步，愛情也開始萌芽。

programme.title: 時光之城
programme.desc: 【橫跨兩國人氣演員的偶像劇，張哲瀚攜手朴敏英初嘗試愛情羅曼史！！】樂觀積極的元氣少女許真，在前往蓋亞影視應徵時撞見了當紅炸子雞顧持鈞被前女友拒絕的場面。不希望丟臉的事情曝光的顧持鈞則從中作梗想趕走許真，卻陰錯陽差的在蓋亞集團二公子林晉修的幫助下，反而成為了顧持鈞的助理。朝夕相處、情愫蔓延，卻同時捲入了集團的陰謀，兩人要如何逃出危機，讓有情人終成眷屬呢?

programme.title: 壞記憶橡皮擦
programme.desc: 【金在中攜陳世娫出演新劇《壞記憶橡皮擦》回歸電視劇！！】曾是被看好的網球之星李君，在負傷之後喪失了自尊心，認為自己從人生的主角變成配角。遇上腦研究中心的醫生景珠妍，使用了記憶橡皮擦抹去了過去記憶，重生為運動經紀人，而景珠妍也意外成了他的初戀。因被篡改的記憶開始的羅曼史，在得知真相后其結局將會如何呢？

programme.title: 珠玉在側
programme.desc: 【不務正業公子雯珺陰錯陽差納ㄚ環玉薦師徐璐！！】個性古靈精怪的單單單，一心想成為薦玉師卻苦無機會，只能幫姐姐單雙雙賣些假玉，一次交易過程中無意得罪了富家玩絝公子裴沛，彼此留下很差的印象。又因突發危機單單單走投無路入府成為ㄚ環，府邸主人意外是裴沛，單單單也在調笑皆非中與裴沛逐漸相知相惜。

programme.title: 時光之城
programme.desc: 【橫跨兩國人氣演員的偶像劇，張哲瀚攜手朴敏英初嘗試愛情羅曼史！！】樂觀積極的元氣少女許真，在前往蓋亞影視應徵時撞見了當紅炸子雞顧持鈞被前女友拒絕的場面。不希望丟臉的事情曝光的顧持鈞則從中作梗想趕走許真，卻陰錯陽差的在蓋亞集團二公子林晉修的幫助下，反而成為了顧持鈞的助理。朝夕相處、情愫蔓延，卻同時捲入了集團的陰謀，兩人要如何逃出危機，讓有情人終成眷屬呢?

programme.title: 我的野蠻王妃
programme.desc: 【神級經典韓劇，尹恩惠、朱智勳、金楨勳、宋智孝再現現代宮廷指腹為婚！！】申采靜原本只是一名平凡無奇的高中學生，得知爺爺的遺囑中，她與皇太子李信有婚約在身。因家中債務的原因，在無可奈何的情況完婚。待在皇室的申采靜對宮內生活十分反彈，此時海歸回來的皇位第二繼承者李律及李信前女友閔孝琳的存在，展開錯綜複雜的故事。

programme.title: 另一種藍
programme.desc: 【宋茜邂逅周渝民，事業失意返鄉傳承青花瓷再現風華！！】北漂少女陳小滿努力工作、省吃儉用為求入股家族瓷器事業，卻以失敗收場，毅然決然回景德鎮專心學習瓷器工藝。陳小滿工作的上司柯巖則在投資上遭遇前所未有的失利，輾轉來到景德鎮。處於低潮的兩人在互相治癒中重新找回站起來的力量，事業重新起步，愛情也開始萌芽。

programme.title: 豬豬俠之超星五靈俠S2
programme.desc: 豬豬俠與同伴接收到來自九霄星的求救信號，儘管他們已經失去了強大的超能力，但熱心腸的豬豬們仍然義無反顧地再次啓航，前往那個充滿未知數的陌生星球。來到九霄星後，豬豬們看到了整個星球的地表都被灼熱的岩漿覆蓋，而空中竟然懸浮着許多壯觀宏大、各具特色的天空之城。但是，這些天空之城正在陸續失去能讓它們懸浮的五靈元素，面臨墜毀的威脅。豬豬俠等人尋找背後的原因，並耍起功夫，抵抗反派邪惡力量，使出渾身解數拯救天空之城。一場守護正義、保護天空之城的全新冒險之旅開始啦。

programme.title: 紙之月
programme.desc: 【完美善良主婦為小王盜用公款!尋找自由只是為了空虛的愛?】講述家庭主婦劉怡華（金瑞亨飾）在婚姻中得不到丈夫關心，日復一日過著枯燥乏味的生活，她開始復職到銀行上班後，想找回自身的價值。原本頗得客戶信賴，不過在一次意外挪用客戶的錢後，她從中嚐到自由的滋味，接著陷入無法自拔的漩渦中。《夏娃的醜聞》裕善將飾演她的閨蜜柳秋天、《邪門》徐令姬飾演想躋身上流社會的家庭主婦。此片改編自日本小說，其日本電視及電影版在日本得獎無數。

programme.title: 奶酪陷阱
programme.desc: 【金高銀與朴海鎮領銜，知名主角群展現校園青春浪漫！！】大學新生洪雪面對完美又腹黑的劉正學長，因獨特魅力逐漸受他吸引。隨著兩人情意漸濃，劉正的神秘性個性和控制慾逐漸浮出水面，兩人微妙的心理戰，以及性格不羈同學的白仁浩再洪雪身邊守候，三人的矛盾、最終洪雪情歸何處?

programme.title: 韓國小姐
programme.desc: 【2023百想最佳男主角李聖旻社區大叔們聯手打造韓國小姐】高中時自恃美貌過人，而沒有好好唸書的吳智英，畢業後憑藉外表當上百貨的電梯小姐，看似光鮮亮麗的工作，背後隱藏著許多辛酸，面對毛手毛腳的變態上司，以及百貨種種不合理的工作規定，年紀增長且缺乏競爭力另吳智英後悔莫及，偶然的機會下，與現職化妝品公司社長的前男友相遇，公司即將倒閉的金亨俊，與債主鄭先生一同把平凡女孩打造為頂級韓國小姐的勵志故事。

programme.title: 只屬於我的你
programme.desc: 【渣男律師劈腿富豪千金李敏英逆襲成知名設計師】恩靜與律師姜勝宰結婚後，原以為會享受奢華生活，但現實卻是在婆家被當成傭人使喚。婆婆因恩靜沒有家世而感到丟臉，勝宰也漸漸冷淡，甚至不願承認老婆。事實上，恩靜發現勝宰根本沒有辦理結婚登記，當她為了幫助妹妹處理財務問題，辦理貸款時才揭露了這個真相。不久後她發現老公與BJ集團繼承人有染，決心離開傷心地，重返職場成為知名設計師。與此同時，昔日男友俊夏重新進入她的生活，默默支持她，希望能給她真正的幸福。

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 現在開始是Showtime！
programme.desc: 【操縱幻術的魔術師朴海鎮×通靈女警秦基周，靈異喜劇Showtime！！】神秘又搞怪的魔術師車次雄，不僅能操縱幻術，還能使喚鬼魂，這群「幽靈助手」是他的得力夥伴。熱血女警高瑟海，擁有通靈能力，她對靈異現象毫不畏懼。兩人因一起調查超自然案件而結盟，一邊與鬼神合作，一邊大展魔術與正義力量。當喜劇、靈異與調查結合，愛情與真相也心動牽引。

programme.title: 落花時節又逢君
programme.desc: 【小花妖胡意旋強撩告白高冷花神劉學義，大談反差萌戀！！】不懂情愛、呆萌率直的小花妖紅凝，為了報恩誤闖仙界，卻意外發現自己口中的「仙女姐姐」，竟是身為花神的錦繡。紅凝大膽示愛，直言想當錦繡的「天后」，不是拉著他一起睡覺就是要陪他洗澡，讓這位必須斷情絕愛、恪守仙妖界限的未來天帝繼承者瞬間亂了方寸。

programme.title: 小歡喜
programme.desc: 【望子成龍！都會家庭的高考大作戰】以三個家庭為主軸，方圓和童文潔一家三口，他們的兒子方一凡即將面臨高考，但父母的壓力與兒子的無憂形成鮮明對比，使得家庭關係逐漸緊張。另一方面，單親媽媽宋倩與女兒喬英子的生活也充滿了挑戰，前夫的糾纏和女兒的叛逆讓她左右為難。最後，季楊楊從小被寄養在舅舅家，父母突然的關懷讓他陷入矛盾，父親季勝利努力與他建立親子關係，但結果並不理想。這些家庭的故事交織在一起，展現了現代都市生活中家庭、親情和成長的種種困境和溫暖時刻。

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - The Babies' trip to the Moon
programme.desc: The Babies are fascinated by the moon! Troy selects the most cosmic truck to help them get there: Rocky the Rocket!

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - QUACK-QUACK - SUPERJUMP! ROOKIE AND THE FROG
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting by a pond when he suddenly sees eyes staring at him from the water. Thinking of his friend the crocodile, he first keeps a safe distance, but then realizes that it is a cool frog that jumps out of the water and performs some awesome tricks. Rookie watches and tries to copy, and it doesn’t take too long to master such leaps, the frog being an excellent teacher. And when the frog finally falls, Rookie is fast enough to catch it and save it from harm.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - FLY, ROOKIE FLY! ROOKIE AND THE BIRD
programme.desc: Rookie is enjoying a sunny day when he spots a playful little bird drawing circles and shapes in the sky. Inspired to fly, Rookie climbs a tall tree to jump - but after a split second, the only way is down! Quickly, Rookie activates his parachute and lands safely. Although the bird is bursting with laughter, Rookie doesn‘t give u,p and with the help of a giant propeller, he manages to impress his new little friend.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - MOOOO WHO? ROOKIE AND THE BLIND COW
programme.desc: On his tour, Rookie discovers a small cow trapped in a pit and unable to escape on its own. He quickly rushes to its rescue and lifts it to safety. After helping the cow, Rookie realizes the cause of her fall: Very poor eyesight! Rookie presses a button, his body buzzing as he generates a pair of glasses. Rookie puts them on the little cow’s nose - and now she can see everything and even manages a high-fi ve to say goodbye before proudly taking off.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - PICTURE THIS! ROOKIE AND THE CAMERA
programme.desc: Rookie stumbles upon a device, picks it up, and as he goes to examine it, it flashes, and an instant picture comes out. Rookie is thrilled and immediately starts taking pictures of his entire surroundings from all sides and in all sorts of positions. Finally, he has a great idea: In his amazing new photo salon set up in a tent, photo artist Rookie will soon be waiting for all his friends to take wonderful portraits of them!

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BOOKS ARE MAGIC! ROOKIE AND THE LIBRARY
programme.desc: Rookie finds a large library and is fascinated and attracted by all the colorful books. He picks up the first book, but gets frightened when the smiling shark on the cover turns into a ravenous biter after only one page. He chooses another book with a clown’s face and laughs at the funny pictures inside, then one about astronauts and the moon, and another with beautiful landscapes, before he finds an empty, completely white book that gives him a whole new idea.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - DANCE WITH YOUR FRIENDS – ROOKIE THE DJ
programme.desc: On his hike, Rookie discovers a strange, shiny globe hanging from a tree. He gently taps it, and the ball immediately begins to spin, reflecting the light beautifully in all directions: A disco ball! Just behind i, the Rookie finds a DJ booth and soon the music starts and the party begins! Lights are flashing, and all his buddies show up to have a dance with their friends under the sparkling disco ball.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - MY SAND IS MY CASTLE! ROOKIE AND THE CRAB
programme.desc: Rookie enjoys a beautiful day by the sea, playing in the warm sand. He starts to build a sandcastle, which soon gets bigger and bigger soon and notices a crab, which is interested in his building and starts to explore it like his own house. There is a new idea! He presses a button and becomes as small as the little friend, and together they play games inside the sandcastle, before their fun is interrupted by a big wave.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - FRIENDS IN THE SKY, FRIENDS FLYING HIGH? ROOKIE AND THE CLOUDS
programme.desc: What could be better than a meadow of flowers on a beautiful day? Rookie is enjoying the sun and the beautiful blue sky, watching the clouds pass by - but wait! What‘s that? One of the clouds turns, and suddenly its shape reminds him of one of his friends! And who is that again? What a fun game to play! Rookie continues to search for clouds that remind him of his friends and their adventures together.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - The castle of Robins
programme.desc: Since the lens fails to be recovered, Dr. No wants to make another, but he needs robins to make it. So he attacks Rubidia, a region filled with different precious stones. But Oxin the king of Rubidia makes Dr. No his prisoner. And locked him in the castle where Chip is also locked, as Oxin also makes them prisoners to make them work as slaves in his mines. Dr. No try to make Chip to give him back the lens, but Chip denies. Later, the two manage to escape from the castle and Dr. No chases Chip with his craft. But the boy gets the scientist falls into a trap and also helps free the slaves of Rubidia.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - The harmonica trap
programme.desc: Chip and his friends create a zone with formations resembling musical instruments and make sounds harmonious. Suddenly, they become trapped within a rectangle of quartz crystals that vibrate when they form a sonic trap. A musician atom who has caught them, seeks members to assemble an orchestra. The antimatters are near and Chip asked the musician to prepare the trap to retain them and escape. The musician agrees and the antimatters are prisoners of the musician that makes them hear the terrible sound of his compositions.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - OCTO-DANCE! ROOKIE AND THE OCTOPUS
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting on the shore, enjoying the sun, when he sees something repeatedly poking out of the water, sparking his curiosity. He puts on his underwater robot mask and dives into the ocean. At first, all he finds are rocks and coral, but suddenly, big, round eyes are staring at him from a gray rock. He flees in panic, but when he realizes that it is an octopus whose tentacles are tangled in plastic waste, he quickly frees his new friend from this unpleasant situation, and they dance happily together in the water

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - GAME ON? ROOKIE AND THE COMPUTER
programme.desc: Rookie comes across an office cubicle with a computer on the table and is immediately fascinated. He presses some keys, a little character appears on the screen, and a computer game starts. Very excited, Rookie continues to press different keys. When in the end he wins the race and earns a trophy, the computer suddenly takes Rookie‘s photo and prints it out. However, the printing doesn‘t stop, and soon the whole floor is covered with photos before Rookie finally manages to shut down the computer and stop the madness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - LET IT BEEEEE! ROOKIE AND THE BEE
programme.desc: Rookie finds a wooden box, knocks on it, and then shakes it. What a bad idea! The whole swarm of bees chases him, and he has to hide in the bushes. After the swarm is gone, he finds a tired and exhausted bee on the ground. Rookie has the idea to rescue the little bee with a sugar cube. The whole beehive is grateful, and Rookie learns a lot about the work of these useful little friends.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - SNOWBALL EFFECT? ROOKIE AND THE POLAR BEAR
programme.desc: Rookie is happily stomping through the snow when he suddenly gets hit by several snowballs. A pair of cheeky polar bears try to engage him in a playful snowball fight. But Rookie outwits them by hiding in the snow, causing the bears to stumble and then get hit by his surprise robot snowball machine. After the snowy confusion turns to laughter, everyone shares a moment of fun and happiness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - SPRING, SUMMER, FALL & WINTER - ROOKIE AND THE 4 SEASONS
programme.desc: From the window of his house Rookie watches the four seasons pass by and thinks of his friends and the great fun and adventures they had throughout the year: The bees that make everything bloom and the cheeky little ladybug in spring; a day at the beach, snorkeling with friends and a water battle in summer; fl ying kites, fun in the rain and his friend the squirrel getting ready in autumn and building snowmen, snowballs and sledding fun in winter.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - READY, SET, GO! ROOKIE AND THE RABBIT
programme.desc: Rookie is relaxing in the sun when something rushes past him, leaving him in a cloud of dust. Using his telescope, he spots a racing rabbit, and with the tasty prospect of a sweet carrot for the winner, he manages to persuade it to take part in a race. Ready – steady – and off they go: Even though the rabbit stumbles and Rookie has to help, they finish the race together, tumbling happily over the finish line.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BALANCE IN PINK – ROOKIE AND THE FLAMINGO
programme.desc: On his stroll around a lake, Rookie spots a group of pink flamingos gracefully balancing on one leg. Curious, Rookie tries to imitate them and, after practicing a little, manages to do so quite well. But suddenly there‘s a loud splash and Rookie discovers a flamingo struggling to stand on one leg, falling over and over. Offering to help, Rookie comes up with an excellent idea - a pair of roller skates! And there, slowly but surely, the flamingo learns to skate gracefully like a ballerina and to balance on one leg as well.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BOUNCE, REBOUND - SCORE! ROOKIE AND THE GIRAFFE
programme.desc: Rookie is out for a walk on a beautiful day when he suddenly hears a rhythmic sound in the distance. Curious as always, he goes out to investigate and finds a young giraffe playing basketball, skillfully dribbling and bouncing the ball into a basketball hoop high in the trees. Of course, Rookie wants to join in, but he has a few things to learn before their first game. In the end, they impress each other with their skills and tricks.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - The rare earth
programme.desc: Along the way, Chip and his friends find an island surrounded by a large lake of acid, under the constant threat of eruption of a volcano. In the island lives lanthanide atoms, according to the legend, are awaiting the arrival of a "chosen" to give them acid that prevents them from leaving the island. Chip, thanks to his book, discovers that the volcano emitted a base when mixed with the acid may neutralize and make the dangerous lake in a nice extension of salt water.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - The desert
programme.desc: Across a hot desert Chip and the atoms found themselves with a tungsten atom that gives them refuge under a pyramid-shaped building that, until recently, had an ingenious cooling system through which flowed a stream of ammonia in its basement. But now, Dr. No has diverted the flow of ammonia for his own benefit. Chip discovers the point where ammonia diverts and builds a dam that returns to its normal course.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran (S1) - It's time to check the weather forecast

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - Horsey Ride

programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo run a crazy "Hotel" with Dad as their put upon guest. But when Bingo quits over Bluey being too controlling, Dad needs to teach them how to compromise.

programme.title: Roots & Fruits (S1) - Grapes
programme.desc: Live from the Roots &amp; Fruits Theatre, it's the spectacular acrobatic grapes working together to perform the most difficult structures to perfection.

programme.title: Supertato (S1) - Evil Pea Takes a Break
programme.desc: The Cobs try to capture Supertato while Evil Pea is on holiday, but it goes wrong, resulting in Evil Pea getting covered in flour and custard over in the Bath Product's Aisle.

programme.title: Supertato (S1) - Super Birthday
programme.desc: Supertato is delighted when Evil Pea comes to his birthday party but Carrot is suspicious. Soon Evil Pea unleashes the Mini Peas who try to steal Supertato's birthday present.

programme.title: Teletubbies (S1) - Stairs
programme.desc: A musical staircase magically appears in Teletubbyland. Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-Laa and Po take turns making music as they go up and down the stairs.

programme.title: Yakka Dee (S2) - Cat
programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say 'cat' and we go on a whirlwind word adventure! There's a black cat, a white cat, a kitten cat and a purring cat, as well as a very cool cat!

programme.title: Messy goes to OKIDO (S3) - Down the Drain
programme.desc: Messy borrows Zoe's umbrella, and it gets swept away by the rain. Messy and his friends go on a white-water adventure down the drain in search for it.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops (S1) - Wingsuit Yourself
programme.desc: Tao needs help learning to fly his new wingsuit for a big town event, and Mojo and Bo are the experts. Can they help him find his inner bird before it's too late?

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Explorers
programme.desc: While waiting to be picked up from school, Jack plays at being a sailor trying to find his way back home to Australia. Meanwhile, Jack's Dad has got lost on route to collect him.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Perfect
programme.desc: For her Father's Day card, Bluey sets out to draw a picture of herself and her father together. While recalling her favourite memories of playing with Bandit, Bluey struggles with the idea that her drawing must be perfect. Chilli tries to convince Bluey that perfection isn't easy, or absolutely necessary.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S5) - The Face Painting Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are looking for Duggee but can't find him. Instead, they find someone who looks like Enid, only much too big. Duggee has painted his face to look like Enid!

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S5) - The Carrot Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are admiring Duggee's crop of giant carrots when they hear a noise. They find the Rabbits busy preparing for the Carrot Solstice.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - Master of Puppets
programme.desc: At Squirrel Club, there's a story told in blocks, the tale of a first tooth, a fable about changing emotions, and a yarn involving the Squirrels as puppets.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - Cool, Man
programme.desc: At Squirrel Club, Detective Puppy solves the mystery of a missing biscuit, the Rabbits tell us what's cool, and the Squirrels help Delivery Chipmunk with a huge parcel.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S2) - Whistler Mountain, Canada
programme.desc: The Go Jetters are on Whistler Mountain in Canada doing some skiing and checking out the amazing cable car which runs high up between the mountains.

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - Spy Game
programme.desc: When Bingo stops playing Bluey's spy game, their grown-up controlling device stops working properly! Bluey now sees how important Bingo is and needs to win her back!

programme.title: Bluey (S2) - Army
programme.desc: Jack is the new dog at school and the newest recruit in Rusty's Army. Jack struggles with following instructions and always forgets his hat, but Rusty will make a soldier of him yet.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Musical Statues
programme.desc: At the end of a long day, Bluey and her family are out of sync and out of sorts, so Mum gets everyone to play musical statues.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Stories
programme.desc: Indy thinks she's no good because her model horse looks like a cow, but Calypso encourages her not to give up, so she tries to fix it with a little help from Winton.

programme.title: Andy's Aquatic Adventures (S1) - Andy and the Blue Whale
programme.desc: Andy blasts off in his safari sub to the Atlantic Ocean in search of a blue whale.

programme.title: Playtime Towers (S1) - Sticks
programme.desc: Bella and Lift play with a stick that makes the perfect magic wand. They visit Patch, who has a tasty recipe - sticky stick critters!

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S4) - The Difficult Badge
programme.desc: As the Squirrels appreciate Norrie's new bike, they discover that she doesn't know how to ride it, she finds it too difficult.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S4) - The News Badge
programme.desc: After learning that Duggee is making his yearly batch of blueberry jam, a tradition passed on from his great-aunt, the Squirrels decide to spread the news.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S4) - The Ball Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are confused when they see Duggee sitting on a ball because they all have their own favourite way of using it, whether it be kicking, throwing or catching.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S1) - The Nazca Lines, Peru
programme.desc: The Go Jetters race to protect ancient artwork in Peru, when Glitch erases the Nazca Lines.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S1) - The Jigokudani Monkey Park, Japan
programme.desc: The Go Jetters fly to the rescue in Japan, as Glitch gets up to his usual monkey business.

programme.title: Thomas & Friends (S24) - Nia and the Unfriendly Elephant
programme.desc: Nia is excited about being asked to transport a new elephant to the animal park, but the animal is scared of steam trains.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck (S3) - Rainbow Race
programme.desc: The changeable weather means Rainbow has to leave before finishing his story. Sarah &amp; Duck try to find out how the story ends.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck (S3) - Pillow Fill
programme.desc: Scarf Lady helps Sarah &amp; Duck catch the fluffs and puffs to refill their pancaked pillows.

programme.title: Stan Can (S1) - Museum
programme.desc: Stanley and the children tour the museum and quickly realise there's nothing about them or their friends, so they make a new exhibit all about their town today!

programme.title: Stan Can (S1) - Band
programme.desc: Fifi, Little Woo and Fred call up Stanley to ask him to film their new song. They go around the town trying to find the perfect place.

programme.title: Number 1 Newton Avenue (S1) - Double the Fun
programme.desc: Freddie is visiting Aunt Fee, who is baking a cake. Freddie makes a pretend campsite on the rug in the living room for him, Aunt Fee, Alan Acorn and Charlie The Shark.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran (S3) - It's Time For An Easter Feast
programme.desc: JoJo, Gran Gran and all the family plan an Easter feast. When there isn't enough space in the kitchen to prepare the food, it's time for a Gran Gran plan outside in the garden.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Chest
programme.desc: Dad tries to teach Bluey how to play chess, but Mum thinks she is still too young. When Bingo joins in, the kids make up their own rules, but they still can't beat Dad.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Sheep Dog
programme.desc: Dad agrees to play Sheepdog with Bluey and Bingo to stop them from disturbing Mum who is taking a well-earned rest, but looking after a sheep is harder work than they expected.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Housework
programme.desc: Mum and Dad vow to only finish their boring housework when the kids stop acting silly, but that's never going to happen, so they end up trying the same approach themselves.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S2) - The Medicine Badge
programme.desc: Duggee's not very well, he's lost his voice. The Squirrels want to make him feel better. Duggee tries to tell them that he needs some water but the Squirrels don't quite understand, so they ask all the other animals for advice. Does anyone have the answer?

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S2) - The Pizza Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels help Duggee try out his new outdoor pizza oven. Duggee makes the bases, then the Squirrels each put on all the toppings they like best. Some of their combinations are... interesting!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - Song of Peace

programme.title: Teletubbies (S1) - Stairs
programme.desc: A musical staircase magically appears in Teletubbyland. Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-Laa and Po take turns making music as they go up and down the stairs.

programme.title: Hex
programme.desc: This supernatural mystery tells the story of a sickly wife and her maid conspiring to kill her beastly husband, leading to a string of events with spooky twists and turns.

programme.title: A Taste Of Cold Steel
programme.desc: Gan Dai Xiong is killed by Prince Wu, who seeks to seize his Purple Sword. Prince Wu's son join forces with an evil gang to steal the Purple Sword from Gan Dai Xiong's three daughters. Eventually, Gan's daughters team up with their cousin Xu to avenge their father's death.

programme.title: Mist Over Dream Lake
programme.desc: A young girl Chen is sent away by her parents who are going through divorce, to stay with the Chang's. On the Chang's farm, she meets their two sons, the youngest daughter and a young artist, and spends a summer with them that she will never forget.

programme.title: One Way Only
programme.desc: Danny is a motorbike workshop owner, once was a renowned motorcycle racer, but were seriously injured in an illegal race. Mai, student of Danny, wins a race in Macau under Danny's help. However, because of money and honour, Mai joins illegal races. After knowing this, Li persuades Mai to stop illegal races, but Mai seems cannot find his way out...

programme.title: Mission Impossible
programme.desc: A sword master's daughter is pursued and poisoned by an evil master when bringing back the stolen Golden Sword to the palace. She dies on the run and returns as a spirit to take revenge by killing the evil master, and soon vanishes after returning the sword to the emperor.

programme.title: The 5 Billion Dollar Legacy
programme.desc: A crippled billionaire mails a letter to each of his long-lost daughters inviting them to go to Japan, in the hope that he will find a worthy heir to inherit his vast fortune. The sisters finally meet abroad the plane to Japan, and one of them is taken with a man who is going to investigate the death of his lawyer uncle in a mysterious hit-and-run.

programme.title: Ten Tigers of Kwang Tung
programme.desc: The Ten Tigers of Kwang Tung is a group of anti-Ching martial artists who have killed a Ching official. Years later, when five disciples and descendants of Ten Tigers meet one night, one of them is killed by the son of the late Ching official who returns with a vengeance. They must fight against him to protect the Ten Tigers clan...

programme.title: Tropicana Interlude
programme.desc: Ping and Su are lovers who operate a travel agency specializing in Southeast Asian holidays. Tung, a school mistress, and her students join a guided tour lead by Ping. During the trip, a spoiled kid Li is attracted to Ping but Su thinks Ping has fallen for Tung and leaves. How will Ping deal with the situation and ends up happily back with Su?

programme.title: Kid From Kwangtung
programme.desc: After many years as a respected actor and action choreographer, the Shaw Studio finally gave the dependable and commendable Hsu Hsia a chance to direct his own movies. He didn't waste the opportunity, inviting three other kung-fu designers to help on this fight-filled thriller. Wang Yu, co-star of such classics as Dirty Ho and The Kid With A Tattoo, here takes center stage as a young rascal caught between an anti-Ching Confederation and violent, vengeful Ching troops.

programme.title: The Mad Monk
programme.desc: The movie consists of four stories of the Mad Monk helping others, from saving a mother and daughter from crumbling walls, to helping hawkers deal with bullies, recovering stolen money for a young man and punishing a devious court official and his son.

programme.title: The Chinese Boxer
programme.desc: A Japanese karate master and Diao Er, who has been expelled from his martial arts school, return to the school to kill the school master and his disciples. After the massacre, disciple Lei Ming embarks on a vigorous training regime and vows to avenge their deaths. A fatal battle is about to begin...

programme.title: Fast Fingers
programme.desc: After his release from prison, Uncle Bill returns to make a fortune with his past thieving partners. They continue to prey on the unsuspecting public, but are closely watched by the upright police chief, who happens to be the boyfriend of one of Uncle Bill's nieces!

programme.title: Have Sword Will Travel
programme.desc: When the head of a manor loses his kung fu skills, he enlists his nephew and fiancee to escort gold to the capital. Along the way, they encounter a mysterious swordsman and join forces with him to stop bandits from stealing the gold.

programme.title: The Kingdom and the Beauty
programme.desc: Emperor Cheng Te meets country maiden Li Feng on a visit to Southern China. It was love at first sight and the Emperor leaves with a promise that Li Feng would be his empress. When he sends for Li one year later, she was too ill to withstand the arduous journey and arrives just in time to die in the arms of her beloved...

programme.title: The Twelve Gold Medallions
programme.desc: This was one of top three films of 1970 and winner of "Outstanding Drama" at the 9th Golden Horse Awards. The evil minister uses twelve golden medallions to summon war hero Yueh Fei back from the frontline and execute him. A group of wandering warriors, led by Yueh Hua and Chin Ping, try to stop the medallion couriers.

programme.title: The Twelve Gold Medallions
programme.desc: This was one of top three films of 1970 and winner of "Outstanding Drama" at the 9th Golden Horse Awards. The evil minister uses twelve golden medallions to summon war hero Yueh Fei back from the frontline and execute him. A group of wandering warriors, led by Yueh Hua and Chin Ping, try to stop the medallion couriers.

programme.title: Tiger Killer
programme.desc: Wu Song is appointed as chief constable after killing a tiger with his bare hands when drunk. The wife of his brother Wu Da Lang, seduces Wu Song but gets rejected by him, and engages in an affair with a rich man. They poison Wu Da Lang when he finds out about their affair. To avenge his brother's death, Wu Song kills both of them.

programme.title: The Convict Killer
programme.desc: After spending fifteen years in prison on trumped-up charges for drug smuggling, the martial arts master Teng Piao embarks on a journey to take revenge on the person who sets him up - "Black Leopard". Unfortunately for Piao, no one knows the real identity of "Black Leopard", except that there is a black leopard tattoo on his chest.

programme.title: The Deadly Knives
programme.desc: Martial arts student Yen returns from school to defend his family homestead against Japanese financiers after his father is killed. On the way, he meets Hua and falls in love with her. However, Hua discovers that her father is plotting with the Japanese to take Yen's property and wants to murder him. It is a tough choice between family and love...

programme.title: The Shadow Whip
programme.desc: Three hundred thousand worth of silver is robbed by a thief using a whip as the weapon. As it is a signature weapon used by a martial arts master "Shadow Whip", he is suspected and hunted. No one sees him after that. Fifteen years later, a young girl Yang shows up using the same weapon. Who is this girl and what has happened to "Shadow Whip"?

programme.title: Vengeance Of A Snow Girl
programme.desc: A crippled woman seeks vengeance against the four men who killed her parents. However, when she crosses path with a young warrior who falls in love with her, trouble ensues as his father is one of the killers responsible for her family's massacre years ago.

programme.title: Sex, Love and Hate
programme.desc: This masterpiece spins three interconnected tales about Hong Kong society's differing views on love and what women want from love. Follow a trio of Hong Kong women as they explore relationships and fulfil their hopes of finding true love.

programme.title: The Villains
programme.desc: Hung is an orphan seeking help from her wealthy uncle who has two sons but only dotes on the younger son Feng, a playboy. Feng covets the beauty of Hung and rapes her but when she gets pregnant, Hung is wrongfully accused and gets sent off by her uncle to protect Feng. Will Feng be punished for his villainy?

programme.title: Let's Fall In Love
programme.desc: Da Yung, the son of a rich entrepreneur, meets Lian Lian, the niece of a kindergarten principal by chance. They fall into a misunderstanding on the first meeting, causing Da Yung to lose his wallet. Further misunderstanding occurs when he tries to get her to act as his fiance so as to drive away two women whom he does not like...

programme.title: Tales of a Eunuch
programme.desc: Wei Xiao Bao enters the palace and unexpectedly befriends Emperor Kang Xi. At the same time, he is assigned by a revolutionary group to steal the valuable "Sutra of 42 Chapters," which Emperor Kang Xi himself is also seeking. Demonstrating keen intelligence, Xiao Bao deftly navigates between opposing factions and successfully evades danger.

programme.title: Tragic Commitment
programme.desc: When the husband of a doctor, Tung is fatally wounded in an accident, he reveals to her about his affair with Blackie, who is impregnated with his baby. Despite the devastation of the betrayal and the eventual death of her husband, Tung is pressured by her mother-in-law into putting up with Blackie and offer $1M for her baby...

programme.title: The Sword Stained with Royal Blood
programme.desc: Adapted from Jin Yong's novel, the movie depicts the havoc breaking out in the martial arts world when a warrior on the run uncovers a sword, a training manual, a treasure map and a secret message on the body of a deceased martial arts master.

programme.title: The House of 72 Tenants
programme.desc: The 72 inhabitants of a dilapidated tenement live under the thumb of a heartless landlady and her sleazy husband. The arrival of a defiant new tenant however, changes their fate. The residents pool their resources together to prevent evictions, deflect targeted harassment by a corrupt policeman and ultimately prevent their home from being sold.

programme.title: The Kung-fu Instructor
programme.desc: Wong Yang is a famous martial artist who is forced to teach kung fu to the Mong Clan, an evil clan which is trying to destroy its nemesis, the Chow Clan. Chow Ping from the Chow Clan is a student of Wong's caught in the Mong's territory and as punishment, the Mong Clan wants to cut off Chow Ping's limbs. Wong steps in to defend his student.

programme.title: Mr Funny - bone
programme.desc: Join Mr Funny bone in a series of comic vignettes as he attempts to win the heart of a dashing lady. Along for the ride is his loyal sidekick Mr Big Potato, a stout fellow who is forever getting into silly mishaps. The pair gets involved in plenty of shenanigans and gags!

programme.title: Mr Funny - bone
programme.desc: Join Mr Funny bone in a series of comic vignettes as he attempts to win the heart of a dashing lady. Along for the ride is his loyal sidekick Mr Big Potato, a stout fellow who is forever getting into silly mishaps. The pair gets involved in plenty of shenanigans and gags!

programme.title: The Silent Swordsman
programme.desc: This is adapted from Louis Cha's "The Book and the Sword". A young swordsman is tasked to lead a patriotic secret society to fight the traitorous general who colludes with the enemy. At the same time, he encounters a female warrior and two beautiful princesses, and is caught between all their affections for him.

programme.title: The Happiest Moment
programme.desc: This erotic comedy anthology features three stories about an old man who dies from an overdose of virility pills, a cop who goes on the run after extorting money from a hooker, and a barber's apprentice who encounters a lively corpse in a night vigil. Through playing all these characters, Michael Hui proves himself as a genius of Hong Kong comedy.

programme.title: The Crimson Palm
programme.desc: Poor student Lin is engaged to the daughter of a rich man who despises him because of his family's declining status. Lin visits his fiancee before leaving for the Imperial examination, but finds a maid lying dead in blood. As Lin's bloody handprint is left on the site, he is accused of the murder. How can Justice Bao prove his innocence?

programme.title: Between Tears and Smiles
programme.desc: Fan Jia Shu is a kind-hearted student who is smitten with Shen, a heart-rending love song singer. However, he is not the only one who has eyes for Shen. The General's henchmen are also determined to present the songstress to their superior as a gift. Fan receives help from an unexpected person just in time to save the woman he loves.

programme.title: The Story of Sue San
programme.desc: TIn this Huangmei Opera romance, Wang is the son of a respected government official whereas Sue San is a famous prostitute. Although they love each other and seem to be perfectly matched, the two are worlds apart when it comes to social ranking, which will prove hard to overcome...

programme.title: Call to Arms
programme.desc: The aggressive and dangerous Chin Empire conquers the hard-put Chao kingdom while the Wei empire is drained of its heroes and paralyzed by an indecisive ruler. Adventure, intrigue, death and tragedy reigns before the triumphant clash of the armies.

programme.title: Spring Blossoms
programme.desc: Some of Shaw Brothers' biggest female stars of the 1970s share the screen in this tale of young love and interfering parents, starring Lily Li, Shu Pei Pei and Essie Lin Chia.

programme.title: The Supreme Swordsman
programme.desc: After beating several famous swordsmen, Chin Wu Hsin of the Mo Shan clan challenges Supreme Swordsman to a duel, hoping to win his title, and is beaten and humiliated. The winner taunts him to find a Supreme Sword made by Old Eagle, a famous sword-maker. When his offer to buy a sword from Old Eagle, is turned down, he challenges Old Eagle to a duel, and snatches his sword in a foul play. Old Eagle's own son Shih Yen-peh vows to avenge for his father...

programme.title: A Place to Call Home
programme.desc: Li Ching, star of Sweet is Revenge, plays one of three daughters, whose life is turned upside down when she discovers she is adopted. But things get even worse when she goes in search of her real mother. Finally, after what is almost a double tragedy, she realizes what so many knew all along: There's no place like home.

programme.title: The Duel of the Century
programme.desc: A duel has been arranged at the Forbidden City between two formidable swordsmen of the martial world, Ye Gu Cheng and Xi Men Chui Xue. Lu Xiao Feng smells something fishy about the duel as the two swordsmen never met and do not have any conflicts. He decides to investigate more with Hua Man Lou, and eventually uncovers some hidden conspiracies...

programme.title: The Last Tempest
programme.desc: This sequel to The Empress Dowager continues the tale of Emperor Guangxu and Empress Dowager Cixi. Despite Guangxu's enthronement, his ability to rule effectively is overshadowed by the ever-present power of Cixi. When his attempts to reform the Imperial system are thwarted by the Empress Dowager, Guangxu attempts to curb her power.

programme.title: The Swift Knight
programme.desc: The Ming Emperor is dying with no heir to succeed the throne. His brother recalls that he has an illegitimate child with a court lady years ago and palace guards are sent to search for the heir. When the Emperor's nephew hires assassins to kill the child so he can be the successor, the Swift Knight comes to the rescue...

programme.title: The Warlord
programme.desc: A bandit became a warlord in northern China by helping Russia fight against Japan. Due to his ignorance and silly behaviour, he is seen as a joke to everyone. The warlord is finally killed by the daughter of a troupe master whom he had killed for no reason, bringing a befitting end to a traitor.

programme.title: The Winged Tiger
programme.desc: If the two big villains Winged Tiger and Underworld King join forces, the martial arts world will be plunged into chaos. This evil union is set to occur with the marriage of the Underworld King's sister and the Winged Tiger. Can this dangerous duo be stopped before one says "I do"?

programme.title: Whatever You Want
programme.desc: An illegitimate daughter of a businessman gets three wishes from a genie, Bo. However, Bo's magical power is far from perfect, leading to much hilarity in this charming fantasy comedy.

programme.title: The Case of Disappearances
programme.desc: In Misty Village, the adopted son Wen Jie is haunted by a recurring nightmare. He delves into a series of disappearance cases in the village to seek his true identity. As more villagers die mysteriously, belief in the curse of Emperor Jing Lung intensifies. Wen Jie teams up with the security chief to unveil the conspiracy and protect the villagers.

programme.title: Young Ip Man: Crisis Time
programme.desc: Set in 1917, young Ip Man pursues his studies in Hong Kong. The school is held hostage on the day of an English speech competition, and as Ip Man decides to step up and fight the crisis, it is revealed that his master and his childhood friend are behind all this. Can he take them down and uphold justice?

programme.title: Mr Vampire Saga 4
programme.desc: A Buddhist monk and Taoist priest put aside their differences to take on vampires that have been struck by lightning and have now become a super powered threat to mankind.

programme.title: Sex Beyond The Grave
programme.desc: During World War II, a singer was raped and killed by Master Tao during her escape, with all her valuables stolen as well. Since then, the Tao's house became haunted. Years later, Master Tao's descendant sells the house to a young couple to pay off a massive gambling debt, but the couple soon discover that it is haunted by the vengeful spirit...

programme.title: Wusong VS Ximenqing
programme.desc: Wu Song finds out about his sister-in-law's affair with a rich man, Ximen Qing. Qing sets Song up and have him exiled for a year, during which his hapless brother is murdered and cremated. When Song finally returns home, he takes the case to court but the judge brushes it aside and closes it abruptly. Can Song finally avenge his brother's death?

programme.title: Faithfully Yours
programme.desc: Playboy Hong Kong Barber Happy Chan opens a fashionable new salon, right next to an old-fashioned Shanhainese barber shop. Its owner, Chuk, is furious at this development and starts a quarrel with Chan and his colleagues during the opening ceremony of his new venture Chuk's pretty daughter, Ying, is forced to keep the peace. Chan and his friends all attempt to woo Ying, but end up getting drunk and falling asleep in her bedroom.

programme.title: The Macaque Monkey
programme.desc: The world is in chaos after the tree of life was burnt. Sun Wu Kong decides to return to the past to resurrect it, but his divine power is unstable after losing the golden hoop, and he must find his younger self to team up to find the power of time. As the six-eared Macaque Monkey also wants the power of time, they clash in a fierce battle...

programme.title: Casino Tycoon II
programme.desc: This is a sequel to "Casino Tycoon". 20 years after Benny Ho established his casino empire in Macau, his former partner becomes envious and plots to bring him down. At the same time, a young man working for Benny is the son of his ex-lover, and is also out to take revenge on him. Ho however, is not about to take things lying down...

programme.title: Painted Faces
programme.desc: This is based on the real-life story of Master Yu Jim Yuen who strives to run his academy in the 1960s, even as the opera culture is declining. Three young men, Sammo Hung, Jackie Chan and Yuen Biao, are determined to train under Master Yu and undergo extremely tough training before they become three of Hong Kong's biggest stars

programme.title: Legend Of The Dragon
programme.desc: A young man Lung leaves his rural home on a small island to seek fortune in Hong Kong. His uncle cons Lung to play in a snooker tournament using his father's land as the bet. Lung lost the match but luckily, his childhood friend Momo encourages him to compete again using her land as the bet. Can he finally win his land back?

programme.title: The Grey Men 2
programme.desc: Triad boss Song seeks to whitewash his image and seize Laika's mayoral seat amid a regime change. He faces a funding shortfall despite colluding with officials, and gets his right-hand man and enforcer to commit crimes to boost his funds and power. Just as Song believes success is imminent, the dynamics between the three take an unexpected turn...

programme.title: Prince Charming
programme.desc: Chen Li Pin, the nerdy son of a business tycoon, and his friend seek love in Hawaii. Returning home in disappointment, they accidentally find themselves in a messy identity swap. It is at this time that Chen falls for a beautiful girl May, who thinks he is a company chauffeur...

programme.title: Royal Tramp II
programme.desc: The leader of Dragon clan, Long Er, helps General Wu to overthrow Emperor Kang Xi. However, Long Er is betrayed by General Wu and is rescued by Xiao Bao. As a result, she bestows her virginity and martial arts power to Xiao Bao to fight against Wu. At the same time, Xiao Bao fortuitously unveils the hidden treasures from "The Sutra of 42 Chapters".

programme.title: Ip Man 2
programme.desc: After the Sino-Japanese war, Wing Chun grandmaster Ip Man and his family experience hardship in their hometown and eventually moved to Hong Kong for a new life. He wants to open a martial arts school in Hong Kong, but first he must pass and win the challenges put forth by the local martial arts grandmasters.

programme.title: Mr Vampire III
programme.desc: Taoist conman Ming fails to banish vengeful spirits and escapes with his ghostly companions. As they seek refuge in a village, they encounter an evil witch whose goal is to eliminate the human race. Ming then allies with Taoist priest Master Jiu to battle the witch-but can they prevail against such overwhelming darkness?

programme.title: Mr Vampire III
programme.desc: Taoist conman Ming fails to banish vengeful spirits and escapes with his ghostly companions. As they seek refuge in a village, they encounter an evil witch whose goal is to eliminate the human race. Ming then allies with Taoist priest Master Jiu to battle the witch-but can they prevail against such overwhelming darkness?

programme.title: Iceman
programme.desc: Falsely accused of murder, Ming Dynasty Imperial Guard Ying is pursued by his three sworn brothers until a fierce battle leaves all four entombed in ice. Four hundred years later, they awaken in modern Hong Kong, where they must reignite their ancient feud in a world they can barely recognize.

programme.title: Jealousy
programme.desc: Model Min is admitted to a hospital, but mysteriously falls to her death at night. Rumour has it that the hospital is haunted. Subsequently, Min's photographer begins receiving eerie phone calls, the writer loses consciousness in a bizarre car accident, and her friend mysteriously disappears...

programme.title: Mr. Possessed
programme.desc: Riley is cursed by an evil spirit to not be able to approach any woman. When he falls in love with Siu Yu, Riley's mother decides to use her to help him vanquish the evil spirit. On their wedding night, Riley passes out after protecting Siu Yu from the attack of the evil spirit. Can the two finally break the curse?

programme.title: Love Punch
programme.desc: Talented boxer Jia Yang is caught in an underground fight to clear her father's debts. She loses her Olympic aspiration and vanishes from the boxing world. 10 years later, Coach Li Yue is determined to help her honour her father's wish by returning to the ring. As passion and obligation collide, can Jia Yang revive her abandoned boxing dream?

programme.title: She is in Danger
programme.desc: After a fight with her boyfriend, Xue leaves home to stay in a remote B&amp;amp;B accommodation, together with a roommate Yi. One night, Xue accidentally discovers that Yi and another friend have killed Yi's ex-boyfriend, and is locked up by the duo so as to cover up the murder. Xue's buddy, Wen, comes seeking for her - can Xue and Wen escape from danger?

programme.title: Fierce Cop
programme.desc: To save his son who has been kidnapped by human traffickers, police officer Zhang relentlessly hunts them down and accidentally finds himself implicated in a major child abduction case. In the process, he teams up with a mysterious lady to crack the international crime syndicate and rescue his son.

programme.title: Mahjong Heroes
programme.desc: A hero helps a young student deflect a cunning and malicious gambling tycoon who is out to take over the student's family business over a game of mahjong.

programme.title: Cruel War
programme.desc: To combat the greenhouse effect, scientist Yan Xin attempts to plant newly developed super rubber seeds on a remote island, hoping to transform it into a thriving new land. Yan Xin's ex-husband decides to accompany her on this perilous journey. As conflicts arise, they encounter the local drug cartel, and a fatal battle is about to begin.

programme.title: Mr Vampire
programme.desc: Taoist priest Kou is assigned to re-bury a rich man, in the hope that the new tomb will bring further prosperity. When the corpse turns into a vampire and wreaks havoc in the village, his disciples are also hurt by the vampire and possessed by a female ghost respectively. How can Kou save his disciples and hunt down the vampire at the same time?

programme.title: Maoshan Heavenly Master
programme.desc: Prisoner Chi flees away under Master Zhang's custody, causing the latter to be expelled from his clan. On his way to find Chi, Master Zhang arrives at a place where many people vanish for no reason. He soon discovers that it is Chi who captures them in his training to become a serpent demon. The war between human and demon has just begun!

programme.title: Out of the Dark
programme.desc: An old lady died after mysteriously falling off a building and her ghost appears to haunt the place. This freaked out the security guards, who invite ghostbuster Leo and his female assistant to help. In the process, Leo finds out that the old lady was killed by her son and daughter in law. To rest her soul, Leo promises to bring the couple to justice.

programme.title: Forbidden City Cop
programme.desc: A wild and hilariously anachronistic tale of an imperial guard of the Forbidden City who has no martial arts abilities. When the emperor is abducted, he saved the day with his unusual hobby: tinkering with futuristic inventions!

programme.title: The Sorcerer &amp; The White Snake
programme.desc: In this action fantasy movie based on the Chinese legend of the White Snake, a young herbalist falls in love with a thousand-year-old white snake disguised as a woman. When the white snake's true identity is revealed, a sorcerer goes to battle believing that in doing so, he is restoring balance and order between man and the supernatural.

programme.title: The Magnificent Scoundrels
programme.desc: Conman Sing is forced by a loan shark to team up with another con artist Betty to steal from a luxurious house. When they encounter other conmen who disguise themselves as the house owners to steal the antiques, they pretend to be their rich guests. As both sides know the other's true identity, they join forces to con the loan shark into a trap.

programme.title: The Illegal Immigrant
programme.desc: This is a gritty and realistic Chinatown tale about the life of a Chinese illegal immigrant and his journey in New York. He is looking for a fake marriage with a girl so as to gain the right of abode there. Despite all the hardships and misfortunes, he tries to cope with life and reach for his dreams.

programme.title: The Illegal Immigrant
programme.desc: This is a gritty and realistic Chinatown tale about the life of a Chinese illegal immigrant and his journey in New York. He is looking for a fake marriage with a girl so as to gain the right of abode there. Despite all the hardships and misfortunes, he tries to cope with life and reach for his dreams.

programme.title: Whisper of Silent Body
programme.desc: Renowned as the "corpse whisperer," forensic pathologist Qin Ming uncovers vital clues from the corpses. During a homicide investigation, he unravels a murder case sixteen years ago in the snowy mountain with his assistant and a detective. Together, they unveil the secrets of the mysterious homicide.

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Ma Wing Jing and his brother arrive in Shanghai to make their fortune. Befriending a powerful mobster Tam, Ma is given his nightclub when he saves Tam's life. Ma's fortune rises but he must overcome the corruption and violence to survive.

programme.title: Cop Shop Babes
programme.desc: Island East Police Station headed by Madam Lui is known for its "Cop Shop Babes" as all the officers there are female. Two police officers, Beer and Satay, apply for an internal transfer to this station in order to approach the girls. It is at this time that the police receives a bomb threat - can they resolve the case?

programme.title: Ghost Wedding
programme.desc: Photographer Zhi Cheng is entangled with a "woman in red", leading to the deaths of his relatives one by one. When the girl he likes, Si Tong, also dies mysteriously, Zhi Cheng vows to find out the truth but ends up revealing the secret of a "ghost marriage"...

programme.title: Nezha
programme.desc: A former top team racing driver wants to prove himself in a race but accidentally hurts his teammate Lily, leading to the team's downfall. When an inexperienced virtual car racing champion joins the team and unexpectedly shines in a real-life race, can the three drivers team up to regain glory for their team?

programme.title: Zombie Island
programme.desc: Jeff, a big fan of zombies, goes to a deserted and mysterious island with his friends hoping to seek out exciting adventures. What started as an adventure turns out to be a horrifying journey as they get trapped on the island and are attacked by the zombies! Their lives are in danger when they fail to fight back, and the game has only just begun!

programme.title: Iceman the Time Traveler
programme.desc: In this sequel, the four imperial guards are defrosted and reanimated in modern Hong Kong. Driven by a single goal to obtain the Golden Wheel of Time and right the wrongs of the past, Ying embarks on a perilous quest, unaware that every step draws him deeper into a deadly trap.

programme.title: Royal Tramp
programme.desc: Wei Xiao Bao is sent by a revolutionary group to be a spy in the imperial palace and find "The Sutra of 42 Chapters". Xiao Bao soon befriends Emperor Kang Xi but must carry out his mission at the same time, so he is caught between two camps.

programme.title: Iron Kung Fu Fist
programme.desc: Liang Kun is a skilled martial arts master who left the martial arts world to protect his lover. However, his disappearance leads to her tragic death and as Liang Kun finds a way to survive in the martial arts world, he fights back to avenge his lover's death with the help of a beggar gang leader.

programme.title: Face to Face
programme.desc: Tamotsu dies in a skiing accident and his roommate Yoshio marries his wife as well as inherits his entire fortune. At Tamotsu's funeral, Yoshio sees a badly disfigured old man and that is only the beginning of an evil downfall for him...

programme.title: The Mask of Shura of Fire Cloud
programme.desc: 18 years ago, the evil Black Feather clan infiltrated the territory of Master Fire Cloud and stole The Mask of Shura, thus releasing an evil spirit that was a baby. Master Fire Cloud adopted the baby to prevent him from becoming evil. When the baby grows up, he takes control of the mask and becomes Fire Cloud's successor as the city's guard.

programme.title: Teenage Dreamers
programme.desc: Ting Ting is a student in an all-girl high school. She tries out for the school's stage production of Romeo and Juliet with an all-boy school and promptly falls for the lead, Jackson. While Ting Ting is swept away by the excitement of her first love, Jackson turns out to be more of a player than a partner.

programme.title: My Darling Genie
programme.desc: A genie who is trapped in a Chinese oil umbrella helps an honorable young man and his uncle to deal with a covetous loan shark.

programme.title: Casino Tycoon
programme.desc: Inspired by the story of Macau's Casino King Stanley Ho, the movie traces his blood-splattered fight to the top from 1930s to 1960s. In 1941, a young graduate, Benny Ho, flees Hong Kong during the Japanese invasion and heads for Macau. Benny starts as a labourer but rises to the top of the city's casino business with his courage, wisdom and diligence.

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: Comparing to the director's previous Hex. This time, however, the stakes are even higher and the gruesome goings-on even more memorable. It all starts when a noble police detective starts investigating a child killer's claims of an evil spell, then it doesn't let up until the final, bloated, maggot-ridden cadaver falls.
